status: SPECIFIED; NOT_RUN (dependencies and downloads not approved)
supersedes: P3-REAL-01 design in STATUS.md (first session). The original text is preserved below; the changes are listed in 'revisions_vs_real01'.
question: For decoder edits of a public ReLU SAE at a fixed layer, how does the SAE-re-encoded change split into target change, drift on originally active non-target features, drift from newly activated/deactivated features, and total non-target drift, as a function of dose, for active vs inactive targets, and how do simple alternatives compare at equal norm and at matched achieved target change?
what_this_cannot_show: Anything about external behaviour or external control. All metrics except quality are computed with the same SAE encoder the correction uses; improvements in them are not evidence of external control.
revisions_vs_real01: Independent unit is the test DOCUMENT, not the feature. Calibration and test are split at the document level before windows are made.
a_max is replaced by calibration-only activation quantiles; norm budgets come from calibration residual norms. Doses are frozen before any test window is encoded.
Features are sampled from a calibration-only pool before test data is touched; no feature or dose is chosen from test results.

G1-G3 are kept verbatim but read as regime-wise curves, paired differences and document-cluster bootstrap intervals; they are operational gates for P3-REAL-02, not significance tests. A large crossing share does not end the measurement study.
Equal-norm comparisons and achieved-target-matched comparisons are reported separately; rows that cannot be matched are kept with status INFEASIBLE.

real01_gate_text_verbatim.G1: the rescaled decoder's protected leakage is < 0.1·α;
real01_gate_text_verbatim.G2: crossing leakage ≥ protected leakage for the rescaled decoder;
real01_gate_text_verbatim.G3: `jacobian_ln` total leakage ≥ the rescaled decoder's in ≥ 50% of features.
real01_gate_text_verbatim.original_condition: STOP the method claim if any of the following holds at α ≥ 1·a_max (median over test features)

gate_reinterpretation.G1_readout: curve of median (over documents) drift_orig_active_rel for calibration-rescaled decoder vs dose, with 95% document-cluster bootstrap interval; gate reads the interval at q99 against 0.1
gate_reinterpretation.G2_readout: per-document paired difference drift_newly_active_rel - drift_orig_active_rel for calibration-rescaled decoder at q99; bootstrap interval
gate_reinterpretation.G3_readout: per-document paired difference drift_all_nontarget_rel(jacobian_ln) - drift_all_nontarget_rel(decoder, target-matched) at q99; bootstrap interval; also the fraction of (document, feature) pairs where the difference is >= 0
gate_reinterpretation.decision: If a gate condition holds with its whole interval on the STOP side, do not run P3-REAL-02 as a method test; still report the measurement study. If intervals straddle the threshold, record INCONCLUSIVE and do not treat it as PASS.
gate_reinterpretation.not_a_test: These readouts are operational decision rules. They are not significance, equivalence or novelty tests.

data.source: Salesforce/wikitext wikitext-103-raw-v1 at the contract revision
data.calibration_documents: all articles in the validation parquet
data.test_documents: all articles in the test parquet
data.document_segmentation: a new article starts at a line matching ^ = [^=].* = $ (level-1 heading)
data.overlap_check: abort if any title or any 128-token window hash occurs in both splits
data.windows: tokenize each document, split into consecutive 127-token chunks, prepend BOS (id 50256) -> 128-token windows; drop the last chunk if shorter than 64 tokens
data.positions: BOS position excluded; positions sampled with a seeded RNG per (document, feature, target_kind)

calibration_only.feature_pool: features with calibration firing density in [1e-4, 1e-2] over non-BOS calibration tokens

norm_budget_doses.reference: median L2 norm of centred calibration residuals at the hook (non-BOS)

calibration_only.freeze: results/real01r/calibration_frozen.json with sha256 recorded in the run manifest; the run stage refuses to start if the file hash differs or if any test document was read during calibration

test_sampling.per_feature: up to N_docs test documents where the feature is active at some non-BOS position (active-target rows; position = a seeded choice among active positions) and N_docs documents where it is inactive at the sampled position (inactive-target rows)
test_sampling.N_docs_choice: largest value in [8, 16, 32] whose projected wall clock from the timing smoke (calibration windows only) fits the budget; chosen before any test window is encoded
test_sampling.note: active-target rows condition on the pre-edit state of the test point only, never on outcomes

methods.decoder_calib_rescaled: delta = (alpha / (W_enc[:,j] . W_dec[j])) * W_dec[j]; weight-only coefficient, no test information; INFEASIBLE if the denominator <= 0
methods.jacobian_ln: delta = M^+ t with M = W_enc[:, S u P]^T, P = non-target features active at the test point, t = (dp_req, 0, ..., 0); least-norm solve on |S u P| x 768
methods.random: delta = s * r, r Gaussian with a seed per row (sanity control)
methods.not_included: SAE-TS / FGAA need a fitted effect model from many steering runs (not reproducible within this CPU budget); recorded as NOT_RUN baselines. DiffMean needs a concept label and belongs to P3-REAL-02.

comparison_modes.equal_norm: each direction u is scaled to ||delta|| = rho (norm-budget doses) with the sign chosen so that W_enc[:,j] . delta > 0; jacobian_ln uses its least-norm direction scaled to rho
comparison_modes.target_matched: for each target-change dose alpha, a scalar s >= 0 is solved so the achieved post-activation change on j equals alpha (closed form for ReLU: s = (a_j + alpha - p_j) / (W_enc[:,j] . u)); jacobian_ln matches by construction; decoder_calib_rescaled is reported unmatched (deployable baseline). Rows where no s >= 0 exists are kept with status INFEASIBLE and a reason.

coordinates: edits are defined in TransformerLens (centred) coordinates; the SAE reads x + delta; the model runs on h + delta; mean(delta) is recorded (contract file, 'hook.coordinates')

quality: kl_next_token_mean over positions pos..pos+15 (edited vs clean)

uncertainty: document-cluster bootstrap (2000 resamples, seed 0) over test documents for medians and paired differences; features are fixed effects

budget.downloads: listed in the contract (703,545,978 bytes of model/SAE/data files) plus Python packages (sizes not verified)
